title: Key Laboratory of Rubber-Plastics, Qingdao University of Science and Technology
content:
Aerogel University Research Platform. The Key Laboratory of Rubber-Plastics at Qingdao University of Science and Technology operates under the Ministry of Education and is also a Shandong Provincial Key Laboratory. Based in Qingdao, it is one of China's leading research centers for rubber, plastics, polymer composites, and elastomer engineering.

Its teams study polymer nanocomposites, filler networks, and functional porous materials, with published work including graphene aerogels and silica-filled rubber systems. The laboratory's processing, formulation, and characterization expertise makes it a relevant partner for aerogel-polymer composite development, insulation material research, and related performance testing.
